name: overwolf-console
description: Optional companion: bundles the overwolf-console-mcp server plus the overwolf-console-analyst skill so your AI can query your app's Overwolf Developer Console analytics (DAU/MAU, retention, installs, crashes, ads revenue) and knows the stats API's gotchas. Opt-in and credentials-gated.

email.title: Overwolf account email
email.description: The email of your Overwolf Developer Console account.

api_key.title: Overwolf Console API key
api_key.description: From the Overwolf Developer Console -> Settings -> Profile -> 'Revoke and get new API key'.

default_app_id.title: Default app ID (optional)
default_app_id.description: Your Overwolf app's UID. Optional — if set, queries default to it instead of needing an app_id each time.
